name: Juumonji Ayumi
source:
She is a talented young woman with excellent results. She has already received a number of job offers in this difficult job market.

She is strong-willed and does not take kindly to flirting with men. Nevertheless, Her first choice for a job is Fagles. She is a little nervous about this interview.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/urasyukatsu/index.html]official site[/url]]
